name: King of Vikings
source: King of Vikings is an adventure visual novel set in Viking fantasy land. Ragnar the Silver, a Viking noble summoned by Queen Mathilde to defeat this tentacled menace by assembling an elite unit of warriors.
translation: 《维京之王》是一部以维京幻想之地为背景的冒险视觉小说。白银拉格纳是一位维京贵族，受玛蒂尔德女王的召唤，集结了一支精英战士部队，以击败这种触手威胁。
